items.description: account read by id with no ownership check (the statement route right below calls assertOwns)
any caller, including the person who created the transfer, can approve a pending transfer: no maker-checker separation and no role check
/admin/reports export of every transfer without the @PreAuthorize hasRole('ADMIN') that AdminController has

class-level @PreAuthorize hasRole ADMIN covers list and delete
